Please reply with:
1) The email address on your account (or your **first name + last name + ZIP code**), and  
2) Your **order id** (e.g., **#W0000000**), and  
3) What payment method you want any price difference/refund to use for the exchanges (**gift card**, **PayPal**, or **credit card**)—if you don’t know, tell me what you used originally.

Once I have the order id and your payment method, I’ll look up the specific item ids and confirm the exact keyboard + thermostat swap options before submitting the exchange.

Sure! My name is Yusuf Rossi and my zip code is 19122. The order ID is #W2378156. I used a credit card for the original purchase, so please use that for any refund or price difference.

Let me know what options are available for the keyboard and thermostat swaps.
